title: SG-2.2 · Move game runtime from backend/game to top-level game/
summary: Relocate the TypeScript game runtime and content to the top-level game/ folder and keep its tests and config passing
description: Context: the game runtime (src/engine, src/state, src/systems, src/content, content/worlds/the-boys-room, tests, vitest/tsconfig/package.json) currently lives in backend/game. The goal specifies a top-level game/ module separate from the Go backend. Desired behavior: the same files live under game/ with unchanged relative layout, the old backend/game folder is gone, and the tests still pass. Why: separation of runtime concerns from the Go backend.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, when listing game/, then game/src/engine, game/src/state, game/src/systems, game/content and game/tests exist and backend/game does not
Given game/, when running vitest there, then all existing tests pass with no changes to src logic
Given .gitignore, when read, then it ignores game/node_modules/ and no longer references backend/game

in_scope: git mv of backend/game to game
fixing path references in config and ignore files
out_of_scope: changes to engine or system logic

technical_constraints: Use git mv to retain history
Relative imports in src and tests must keep working unchanged
